description: This file implements the SQL store for role management in Mattermost, including role creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and querying role permissions within channel and team schemes.

classes.name: SqlRoleStore
classes.description: Struct implementing role storage operations using SQL database.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Struct representing a role entity with its properties.

classes.name: channelRolesPermissions
classes.description: Struct for holding permissions related to channel roles.

methods.name: NewRoleFromModel
methods.description: Converts a model.Role to a Role database entity, aggregating permissions into a string.

methods.name: ToModel
methods.description: Converts a Role database entity back to a model.Role.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Creates or updates a role in the database, handling validation and transaction management.

methods.name: createRole
methods.description: Inserts a new role record into the database within a transaction.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a role by its ID.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all roles from the database.

methods.name: GetByName
methods.description: Retrieves a role by its name within a given context.

methods.name: GetByNames
methods.description: Retrieves multiple roles by their names.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Soft deletes a role by setting its DeleteAt timestamp.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all roles permanently from the database.

methods.name: channelHigherScopedPermissionsQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL query string for fetching higher scoped permissions for roles.

methods.name: ChannelHigherScopedPermissions
methods.description: Fetches higher scoped permissions for given role names.

methods.name: AllChannelSchemeRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all roles associated with channel schemes.

methods.name: ChannelRolesUnderTeamRole
methods.description: Finds all channel-scheme roles under a specific team role.
